title: Implement Dwg Import and Export for All Technologies
description: Implement a self-contained, hand-rolled, pure-Rust DWG R2000 (AC1015) codec (reader + writer, WASM-compatible, no external crates/FFI) in framework/core/rs/lib.rs, then wire DWG import and export through the OS media layer for every 2D/3D technology (kernel 2d, kernel 3d brep, draw, procedural 2d/3d, cad, puzzle 2d/3d/5d, lowpoly, layout, gis, raster, note, shooting, presentation). Mirrors the existing SVG/PNG/OBJ/GLB export infrastructure and adds a net-new import registry (the OS media layer is currently export-only). Plan approved and stored at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/implement-dwg-import-and-shimmering-salamander.md.
summary:
Implemented a hand-rolled, pure-Rust DWG R2000 (AC1015) codec and wired DWG import/export through the OS media layer for every 2D/3D technology in the repo.

**Codec** (framework/core/rs/lib.rs, region `Dwg`): bit-stream primitives (BS/BL/BD/handle refs/CRC-16), a DwgDrawing/DwgEntity/DwgGeometry model covering Line/Point/Circle/Arc/Ellipse/LwPolyline/Spline/Text/Face3d/Polyline3d/PolyfaceMesh, dwg_to_bytes/dwg_from_bytes, and mesh/path bridges (mesh_to_dwg_drawing, dwg_drawing_to_mesh, paths_to_dwg_drawing, dwg_drawing_to_paths). 8 new tests, all passing. Scope note: container framing (magic/locators/sentinels/CRC/object-map) follows the real AC1015 structure; the full mandatory AutoCAD table set (BLOCK_CONTROL, STYLE, LTYPE, etc.) was intentionally left out since there was no DWG viewer/oracle available in this sandbox to validate byte-exact third-party compatibility — the codec is fully round-trip correct and tested against itself, but a follow-up ticket should validate a real AutoCAD-authored file against the reader and vice versa.

**OS media layer** (framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs): renamed OsMediaExportFormat→OsMediaFormat, added Dwg variant; fixed a pre-existing bug where most 2D/3D resource kinds had dimension "unknown" (making coverage checks vacuous); added a net-new import registry (register_os_media_import_handler, required_os_media_import_formats, assert_os_media_import_coverage, import_os_app_instance_media) mirroring the export registry, which previously didn't exist at all; added an SVG→DWG funnel (svg_to_dwg_bytes) reusing the vendored usvg parser so every 2D tech gets DWG export for free; extended the mesh registrar for 3D techs.

**All 15 resource kinds wired** for both export and import: 2d.drawing (draw — native high-fidelity converter with bulge arcs and DWG TEXT, not the generic funnel), 3d.mesh, 3d.lowpoly, 3d.cad, 2d.note, 2d.raster, 2d.map, 2d.layout, presentation.deck, 2d.puzzle, 3d.puzzle, 5d.puzzle, 2d.shooting, 2d.procedural, 3d.procedural.

**Kernels**: added export_dwg/import_dwg to both BrepKernel (kernel/3d/brep) and DrawingKernel (kernel/2d), with round-trip tests.

**Flow ops**: brep.io.exportDwg/importDwg operators, draw-module export_dwg_json/import_dwg_json, flow-core wasm forwards (export_drawing_dwg/import_drawing_dwg) plus dwg_encode_mesh_json/dwg_decode_mesh_json utilities.

**JS bridges**: kernel-2d-js (exportDwg/importDwg), kernel-3d-js (brep-js exportDwg/importDwg), cad brepjs (exportModelSpaceToDwg — import was scoped out since ModelSpace solids require real BREP shapes and brepjs has no mesh-ingestion path; the working 3d.cad DWG import goes through the Rust kernel instead).

**Shell/UI wiring**: VFS now lists an import.dwg row per 2D/3D instance; ui-interpreter.tsx handles os://import/ URIs (and fixed a pre-existing bug in the os://export/ URI parser that made exportMedia dead code); s-plugin gained importMedia/importMediaPayload commands and a fixed exportMedia (was passing an empty document and dropping the encoding field); wgpu native shell gained binary file read/write support for the download/import file dialogs.

All changes verified via cargo test/build and JS vitest runs, not just written — every crate and package listed below was compiled and its test suite run green (aside from several pre-existing, unrelated failures/warnings from concurrent work in this fast-moving repo, e.g. a RasterScene field refactor mid-flight in the wgpu renderer, camera-zoom and brush-UI flakiness in puzzle-plugin, HashSet-ordering flakiness in gis-plugin, and a STEP property-derivation test in brepjs — none reference DWG code).
